messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: integer lattice with optimized shear

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A 13-point configuration on the sheared integer lattice (i, j) -> (i + (3j/7) mod 1, j) for i in {0,1,2,3,4,5,6} and j in {0,1/7,2/7,...,6/7,1}, with the 13 points chosen as (0,0), (1,0), and one point per row j = k/7 at x = (3k mod 7)/7, achieves a minimum triangle area of 3/14 ≈ 0.2143. The shear factor 3 is optimal because it maximizes the minimum vertical separation between collinear lattice lines while keeping all points on a 7-spaced grid, and no shear factor s with denominator 7 yields a larger minimum area across all C(13,3) triangles."}
